evidence.quote: Applicants with international educational qualifications: 15 June
Studieninteressierte mit ausländischen Bildungsnachweisen bewerben sich über uni-assist an der Hochschule Osnabrück.

notes: Teaching language: the DAAD page states the programme is taught entirely in German; no English-taught track is indicated. Tuition: the DAAD page states 'Tuition fees per semester None' but the figure is not specific to non-EU/EEA students on this programme, so no tuition fact is extracted. The pages do not list a specific document checklist for this programme, so the documents fact is omitted. Intakes: the DAAD page gives '15 June' for applicants with international educational qualifications, with no year, so it is recorded as a recurring deadline (applicationDeadline null). The programme starts in the winter semester; the exact start date is in September per the programme page. applicationChannel: international applicants apply via uni-assist, not directly through the university portal, and no VPD is mentioned, so 'de-uni-assist' is used.

note.fr: Le diplôme de fin d'études secondaires doit être reconnu comme donnant accès à l'université (Hochschulzugangsberechtigung) ; il est vérifié par uni-assist.
note.en: The school-leaving certificate must be recognised as qualifying for university admission (Hochschulzugangsberechtigung); this is checked by uni-assist.

evidence.quote: Applicants are required to hold a recognised school leaving certificate qualifying them for university admission.
uni-assist prüft, ob dein Schulzeugnis dich zum Studium in Deutschland berechtigt.

note.fr: Le programme est soumis à une procédure de sélection (zulassungsbeschränkt) ; un entretien ou des critères de sélection peuvent s'appliquer.
note.en: The programme is subject to a selection procedure (zulassungsbeschränkt); an interview or selection criteria may apply.

evidence.quote: Zulassungsbeschränkt bedeutet: Es wird ein Auswahlverfahren durchgeführt.
